steps.title: Harness constructor validates config
steps.note: AllternitHarness is instantiated with a HarnessConfig. The constructor immediately validates the config and builds the middleware chain.

steps.title: Build the middleware stack
steps.note: buildMiddleware() orders hooks carefully: refusal fallback first, then user middleware, then retry. This lets fallback intercept refusals before retry consumes attempts.

steps.title: Validate configuration and execution mode
steps.note: validateConfig() ensures a config object exists, requires a supported mode (byok, cloud, local, subprocess), and switches to mode-specific checks.

steps.title: Validate cloud, local, and subprocess modes
steps.note: Each non-BYOK mode validates its own required fields: cloud needs baseURL and accessToken, local needs baseURL, and subprocess needs a command.

steps.title: Stream entry point routes by mode
steps.note: stream() validates the request, runs beforeRequest hooks, injects system/provider prompts, fills maxTokens from the model registry, and dispatches to the mode-specific generator.

steps.title: Collect stream into a response
steps.note: run() consumes the async generator, accumulates text, citations, usage, and stop reason, then applies afterResponse middleware before returning.
